div.head: Grið 13.2
div.ab: 7 se þe man ofslehð binnan cyricderum, sylle þære cyrican CXX scill' be Norðengla lage.
And se þe man ofslehð binnan cyricderum, sylle þære cyrican CXX scillinga be Norðengla lage.
Und wer einen Menschen erschlägt innerhalb der Kirchenportale [Vorhalle], gebe der Kirche 120 Schill. nach Nordengländer Recht.
And whoever kills a person within the church doors [porch] shall give the church 120 shillings according to the law of the northern English.
And anyone who slays a man within the church doors is to give to that church one hundred and twenty shillings according to northern English law.
div.note: Liebermann suggests ‘e’ for ‘y’ in ‘cyricderum’ may be Kentish.
